ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 40 percent white (high intensity) and 60 percent black (low intensity) across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones are located centrally on both lobes near the trailing edge; dark black pigmentation dominates the lower leading edges and infiltrates the white zones through irregular, stochastic mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern; left lobe exhibits roughly 4 distinct high-amplitude peaks, while the right lobe shows a more dense series of 6-8 lower-amplitude peaks along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a concave sweep from the water line, terminating in an upward convex curvature at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-contrast brown and white pixels are concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle encrustations and associated scarring at the distal extremities of both fluke lobes.
